name: Karam KI02 (PN206D) Full Body Safety Harness with Attached Lanyard
shortDescription: Complete fall arrest harness kit featuring dorsal D-ring, adjustable thigh straps, and permanently spliced 2-meter twisted rope lanyard with scaffold hook.
overview: The Karam KI02 (incorporating the PN206D harness) offers an all-in-one, ready-to-use fall protection solution designed specifically for scaffolders, industrial painters, and steel erectors. Fabricated from 44mm wide high-tenacity polyester webbing with black stitching, the harness features a rear dorsal D-ring permanently spliced to a 2.0-meter polyamide 3-strand twisted rope lanyard. The lanyard terminates in a forged steel PN131 scaffold hook with a 50mm gate opening, allowing rapid, secure tie-off to scaffolding pipes, structural angles, and anchorage cables.
keyFeatures: Integrated all-in-one safety kit: Full body harness + 2m lanyard with scaffold hook
44mm high-strength polyester webbing with color-contrasting stitching for easy inspection
Drop-forged rear dorsal D-ring dedicated to fall arrest anchorage
Permanently spliced 2.0m polyamide 3-strand twisted rope lanyard (12mm diameter)
Heavy-duty forged alloy steel scaffold hook (PN131) with 50mm gate opening and double locking
Adjustable shoulder and thigh straps provide custom tailored fit for any body type
Certified to IS 3521:1999 Class A and EN 361 standards
